description: Provision an AWS Kafka Cluster via the ACK kafka controller. Fields mirror the kafka.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Cluster spec.

items.description:
AWSResourceReferenceWrapper provides a wrapper around *AWSResourceReference
type to provide more user friendly syntax for references using 'from' field
Ex:
APIIDRef:

	from:
	  name: my-api

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

brokerNodeGroupInfo.description: Information about the broker nodes in the cluster.

brokerAZDistribution.description:
The distribution of broker nodes across Availability Zones. This is an optional
parameter. If you don't specify it, Amazon MSK gives it the value DEFAULT.
You can also explicitly set this parameter to the value DEFAULT. No other
values are currently allowed.

Amazon MSK distributes the broker nodes evenly across the Availability Zones
that correspond to the subnets you provide when you create the cluster.

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

connectivityInfo.description: Information about the broker access configuration.

networkType.description:
The network type of the cluster, which is IPv4 or DUAL. The DUAL network
type uses both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses for your cluster and its resources.

By default, a cluster uses the IPv4 network type.

storageInfo.description: Contains information about storage volumes attached to MSK broker nodes.

ebsStorageInfo.description:
Contains information about the EBS storage volumes attached to Apache Kafka
broker nodes.

provisionedThroughput.description:
Contains information about provisioned throughput for EBS storage volumes
attached to kafka broker nodes.

clientAuthentication.description: Includes all client authentication related information.

sasl.description: Details for client authentication using SASL.

tls.description: Details for client authentication using TLS.

configurationInfo.description:
Represents the configuration that you want MSK to use for the brokers in
a cluster.

encryptionInTransit.description: The settings for encrypting data in transit.

enhancedMonitoring.description:
Specifies the level of monitoring for the MSK cluster. The possible values
are DEFAULT, PER_BROKER, PER_TOPIC_PER_BROKER, and PER_TOPIC_PER_PARTITION.

numberOfBrokerNodes.description: The number of broker nodes in the cluster.

jmxExporter.description: Indicates whether you want to turn on or turn off the JMX Exporter.

nodeExporter.description: Indicates whether you want to turn on or turn off the Node Exporter.

rebalancing.description:
Specifies if intelligent rebalancing should be turned on for the new MSK
Provisioned cluster with Express brokers. By default, intelligent rebalancing
status is ACTIVE for all new clusters.

status.description:
Intelligent rebalancing status. The default intelligent rebalancing status
is ACTIVE for all new Express-based clusters.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

storageMode.description: This controls storage mode for supported storage tiers.

tags.description: Create tags when creating the cluster.
